notes.title: Calling all tentacle fans! "Apprehending the Adventuer Chan! ~Live2D Tentacles Simulator~" is officially released!!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/324ed2f1aa42c9c21c324dce20394bd8a46b02c3.png[/img]

Published by Alice Publication and developed by No.7 Void Mine, the adult tentacle discipline game "Apprehending the Adventuer Chan! ~Live2D Tentacles Simulator~" is now available on Steam as of today (6/28)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012420/Live2D/

[h3][b]【Story Summary】[/b][/h3] 
One day, Adventurer-chan takes on a quest from the guild to "investigate the strange dungeon appearing near the forest." After beating up a group of slimes on the way to the dungeon, she is caught off guard, ambushed from behind by tentacles, and dragged back to the dungeon, becoming their plaything... 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/b95404e1493d5c6a7c537a3b4af4936a3142a66a.png[/img]

[h3][b]【Gameplay】[/b][/h3] 
This game is a Live2D simulator filled with tentacles and training. Players can control the tentacles to train Adventurer-chan, earn titles to gain SP, and unlock more diverse gameplay, tentacles, and abnormal statuses using SP! Adventurer-chan reacts to different training operations by the player, with all performances fully animated in Live2D. The game includes over 60 titles and more than 35 abnormal statuses! Additionally, it features a simple paper doll system and an expression editor, allowing players to adjust hair, eyes, body, and accessories, as well as customize Adventurer-chan's expressions based on different events and emotions, ensuring that you can stay true to your ideal fetishes!

[h3][b]【Game Features】[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Full of tentacle training
[*] Complete Live2D animations
[*] Highly customizable character system
[*] Diverse titles and abnormal statuses
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/3133fe72ed039381e90351f0f7c8dc41756dff92.png[/img]
